query:
select current_timestamp as observed_at,current_user as observer_role,
 (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as history_count,
 (select jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version desc limit 1) as history_head,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'definer',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig) order by p.proname) from pg_proc p where oid in (
 to_regprocedure('private.in_quiet_hours(public.notification_preferences)'),
 to_regprocedure('private.emit_event(uuid,text,text,text,uuid,integer,text,text,text,text,jsonb,timestamptz)'),
 to_regprocedure('public.rpc_send_agreement_message(uuid,text)'))) as predecessor_functions,
 (select count(*) from pg_attribute where attrelid='public.notification_preferences'::regclass and attnum>0 and not attisdropped) as preference_columns,
 (select count(*) from pg_trigger where tgrelid='public.notification_preferences'::regclass and not tgisinternal) as preference_user_triggers,
 (select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.proname in ('rpc_get_notification_preferences','rpc_set_notification_preferences','notification_preferences_settings','notification_preferences_write_guard')) as n08_functions_present,
 (select count(*) from public.notification_preferences) as preference_count,
 (select count(*) from public.notification_preferences p where not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names z where z.name=p.quiet_timezone) or (p.quiet_hours_enabled and (p.quiet_start is null or p.quiet_end is null)) or p.quiet_start>=time '24:00' or p.quiet_end>=time '24:00') as invalid_preference_count,
 (select count(*) from (select expo_push_token from public.notification_push_devices where active group by expo_push_token having count(*)>1) d) as duplicate_active_tokens,
 (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name='clean_n08_notification_preferences' or version='20260907100000') as n08_history_rows;
